top_signals.title: PB Fintech Won't Tap Equity Market in a Hurry: Chairman
top_signals.summary: Yashish Dahiya, Chairman & Group CEO of PB Fintech, discusses the company's earnings after it reported a 92% jump in first quarter net income. He also said the company will not return to the equity market to raise money in a hurry after it cancelled a planned share sale in February. He spoke exclusively on Bloomberg's 'Insight with Haslinda Amin.' (Source: Bloomberg)
